criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered dark, measured reliefs, strong cover and good slide 2. Slide 3 labels on plates with no visible phone, slide 5 promises a person and draws none, 6 and 7 two grids back to back, 9 small dog over dead concrete, the dog toy-like at full size.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck: one street, one key, one dog, the box changing state; the declared cut to reliefs at 6 and slide 5's interior sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, sources primary, quotes verbatim. Looser spots: slide 5 is c4 verbatim without quotation marks; slide 9's quote gains a full stop inside the marks and the hook gives the city a line from SwRI's release; slide 3 puts a per-clip check on each dog; the web edition goes past c12, c19 and c3 and asserts an unrecorded absence; the future tense on 1 when field work has probably begun.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and where are clear; who decided, why it matters and what a reader can do are missing; the caption's sharpest question is on no frame.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover, slide 2 and the turn at 4 work; 5 restates 3, 6 and 7 repeat, 9 echoes 8.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on house rules; slide 5 a pasted release sentence, slide 9 the city's framing, little San Antonio texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat, a live animal hero; no. 64 was also a lastLight night street about city cameras, and the one-unit-per-object grid relief is the house habit.

ranked_defects.defect: c4 verbatim without quotation marks; repeats slide 3.
ranked_defects.fix: Quote it with 'the release says', or cut the slide.

ranked_defects.defect: Full stop inside the quote marks beyond c14's span; hook gives the city a line from SwRI's release.
ranked_defects.fix: End the quote at 'dogs' with the stop outside; attribute to ACS's director.

ranked_defects.defect: Web edition overreaches c12, c19 and c3 and asserts an unrecorded absence.
ranked_defects.fix: Use the city's sentence, 'paired with' for the software, drop the absence sentence.

ranked_defects.defect: 'for each detected dog' puts a per-clip check on each dog; labels on plates.
Empty 2019 pockets against full 2026 plugs can read as a result difference.
ranked_defects.fix: Draw both as equal plugs differing only in material.

ranked_defects.defect: Future tense though field work has probably begun.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Headline promises a person, none drawn; mid-tone room.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reviewer's shoulder and hand lit by the screen.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Second grid after 6; pockets vs plugs read as a result difference.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Recast 2019 as darker hand-dressed plugs at the same height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Plates, lines off the bottom with no phone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the camera so the lens is in frame.
Camera to 0.5 m at about 3 m.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Block reads as a flat card; plain report plug.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower key; report as a bound sheaf.
